Vehicle Details
Discover the all-new 2027 Chevrolet Bolt RS, an efficient and technology-packed electric vehicle for sale at Lynch Chevrolet of Kenosha in Kenosha, WI. Powered by a 65 kWh propulsion battery, the 2027 Bolt offers an EPA-estimated 262 miles of driving range, making it an excellent choice for daily commuting, errands, and longer trips without using a drop of gasoline.

Charging is designed to be convenient and flexible with 150 kW DC fast-charging capability, 11.5 kW AC charging, a NACS charge port, and an included dual-level charge cord. Whether charging at home or using compatible public fast-charging stations, the 2027 Chevrolet Bolt provides the flexibility EV drivers want.

Inside, the Bolt RS features a Jet Black interior with Red accents, Evotex seating surfaces, heated and ventilated front seats, a heated steering wheel, an 8-way power driver seat, and 60/40 split-folding rear seats. An 11.3-inch color touchscreen with Google built-in and an 11-inch Driver Information Center put navigation, vehicle information, entertainment, and connectivity within easy reach.
